name: Seared Pork Chop with Cranberry-Pear Pan Sauce, Parsnips & Carrots

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and medium dice parsnips and carrots; divide both between two baking sheet pans.
Drizzle veggies with oil and season with spices; stir to combine and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until veggies are golden and tender, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 pork chops, boneless
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; working in batches if necessary, add chops and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove to a clean plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside.
Meanwhile, quarter, core, and small dice pears; place in a medium bowl.
Peel, halve, and small dice onions; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the pear.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: When the chops are done, add more oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom; add pear, onion, garlic, and spices. Cook, stirring occasionally, until pear and onion start to soften, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp thyme, dried
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add broth, cranberries, and honey to the skillet; continue to cook, stirring often, until fruit is tender and sauce is thickened, 3-4 minutes more. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
355 ml chicken or vegetable broth
¾ cup dried cranberries
2 tbsp honey

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide chops and roasted veggies between plates; spoon pan sauce over chops. Enjoy!
